active_subscription_verified.name: active_subscription_verified
active_subscription_verified.value: "merchant_subscriptions"."status" <> 'active' OR ("merchant_subscriptions"."payment_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "merchant_subscriptions"."verification_source" IS NOT NULL AND "merchant_subscriptions"."current_period_ends_at" IS NOT NULL)

pos_item_amounts_valid.name: pos_item_amounts_valid
pos_item_amounts_valid.value: "pos_order_items"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 99 AND "pos_order_items"."unit_price" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000 AND "pos_order_items"."line_total" = "pos_order_items"."unit_price" * "pos_order_items"."quantity"

pos_order_cash_valid.name: pos_order_cash_valid
pos_order_cash_valid.value: ("pos_orders"."payment" = 'cash' AND "pos_orders"."cash_received" IS NOT NULL AND "pos_orders"."change_due" = "pos_orders"."cash_received" - "pos_orders"."total") OR ("pos_orders"."payment" = 'unpaid' AND "pos_orders"."cash_received" IS NULL AND "pos_orders"."change_due" = 0)

pos_order_cancellation_valid.name: pos_order_cancellation_valid
pos_order_cancellation_valid.value: ("pos_orders"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "pos_orders"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pos_orders"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("pos_orders"."cancel_reason")) >= 3) OR ("pos_orders"."status" <> 'cancelled' AND "pos_orders"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "pos_orders"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
